Subject: Q2 outlier reconciliation — proposed normalization & appeals logistics

Team —

Thanks for the previous calibration session. I went through the consolidated distribution and flagged the obvious outliers (attached). Two things I want to propose and get quick alignment on so we can close ratings this week:

1) Normalization rule: for IC bands L4/L5 with fewer than 6 people, do a +/- 0.5 discretionary normalization rather than full re-bucketing. This reduces volatility for small groups.
2) Appeals flow: allow managers one business day (Aug 6 EOD PT) to submit formal appeals with evidence; PeopleOps triages and escalates any edge cases to the exec panel on Aug 7.

Attached: calibration_spreadsheet_Q2.xlsx (master sheet with team-level histograms) and appeals_tracker_2026.csv (empty template).

Please reply with: +1 to both, or specific objection + short rationale by EOD today. If you disagree with the normalization rule, propose an explicit alternative (e.g., absolute headcount floor = 8).

A few quick notes from my read:
- People team: there are four managers where the median was pulled down by one low outlier; those should be handled with normalization rather than re-rating everyone.
- Eng leadership (Vivek): two cross-team IC boundary cases require a brief sync to confirm scope before any rating change.

Thanks — simple, time-boxed, and auditable.

—Aditya Rao
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: calibration_spreadsheet_Q2.xlsx (50KB, xlsx), appeals_tracker_2026.csv (2KB, csv)
